title: The Gospel
definition: The Gospel is the good news that God saves sinners through the life, death, resurrection, and lordship of Jesus Christ.
summary: The Gospel announces that sinners cannot save themselves, but God has provided salvation through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the center of the Gospel: crucified for sin, risen in victory, and Lord over all.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Gospel announces that sinners cannot save themselves, but God has provided salvation through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
